name: Gosari
description: Dried bracken shoots soaked and simmered — the brown strands in bibimbap.

tcm.note: Jue cai is cool and heat-clearing in the Chinese record.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; read with the wild greens.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with wild greens.

histamine.note: Low. Bracken carries ptaquiloside and must be boiled and soaked — a toxicity matter, not histamine.
